depth_targets.title: Connect (SSH / RDP / EC2 Instance Connect / Session Manager)
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi instances aren't real virtual machines with a reachable network stack, so there is nothing to SSH, RDP or Session-Manager into.

depth_targets.title: Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (automated snapshot/AMI policies)
depth_targets.current_reason: Scheduled lifecycle policies aren't modeled; create snapshots and AMIs directly instead.

depth_targets.title: Security group sharing (AWS RAM) and VPC associations
depth_targets.current_reason: Cross-account sharing via AWS Resource Access Manager isn't modeled; every security group stays scoped to this account and its one default VPC.

depth_targets.title: Allowed AMIs, Managed resources, EC2 Serial Console, Auto Scaling group defaults, Zones
depth_targets.current_reason: These account-wide EC2 settings aren't modeled; they have no effect in Vyomi.

depth_targets.title: Target group attributes
depth_targets.current_reason: Stickiness, slow start, deregistration delay and the load-balancing algorithm are stored and returned exactly as set, but there's no real data plane behind them to change traffic distribution.

depth_targets.title: CloudWatch metrics for load balancers and target groups
depth_targets.current_reason: RequestCount, HealthyHostCount, TargetResponseTime and the rest of the ELB CloudWatch metrics aren't published — Vyomi's ELBv2 engine is control-plane only.

depth_targets.title: Trust stores (mutual TLS)
depth_targets.current_reason: Trust store management for ALB mutual TLS isn't part of the EC2 console surface Vyomi simulates.

depth_targets.title: Auto Scaling groups
depth_targets.current_reason: Auto Scaling isn't modeled; launch and manage instances directly.

depth_targets.title: Auto Scaling (offline parity)
depth_targets.current_reason: Offline does NOT route the native autoscaling API at all (routes/aws_s3.py / server.py aws_query_root have no "autoscaling" branch) and the router uses an in-memory AutoScalingStore — make it a durable space-scoped appliance store and route it, so the capability is true offline.
